e2e.environment: dedicated resident audit Chrome via CDP 9333 (persistent profile, reused across runs); chrome-ensure reuse; one tab opened and closed; no temp Chrome/profile

modeLabel: 5 人 · 联机 + AI 补位 / 单人 AI
awards: 2012 Golden Geek Best Party Board Game nominee
2012 BoardGameGeek Best Thematic Board Game nominee

online.transport: HTTP/JSON + 700ms polling; server-authoritative; LAN-only by default

features.rooms: exactly 5 seats; room id + 6-char code + single-use invite token
features.invite: inviteUrl uses the request Host; opens /boardgame/avalon-premium/online.html?room=&code=
features.stateSync: stateVersion + lastAction; every viewer receives the same public state with a per-seat hidden-role projection
features.aiFill: empty seats fill to exactly 5 players with the same engine and AI decision function
features.hiddenRoles: publicView(viewer) returns only the viewer's role plus allowed knowledge tokens; all roles revealed only after the match
features.reconnect: session token + POST /api/rooms/:id/reconnect; reconnect clears timeout takeover
features.timeoutTakeover: no session request for 15s → server AI plays the seat; reconnect restores it
features.leaderboard: GET /api/leaderboard?game=avalon-premium; AI participants included; raw playerId hashed
features.idempotency: per-player idempotencyKey cached before the turn guard

evidence.runAll: test-online.js is auto-discovered by node games/tests/run-all.js

shared.shuffle: games/shared/shuffle.js — engine.js require + index.html script tag; seeded Fisher-Yates for roles
shared.sfx: games/shared/sfx.js — index.html / online.html script tag; no per-game AudioContext
shared.rules: N/A — Avalon rules live in engine.js
shared.leaderboard: shared room server keeps an anonymous in-memory board; no leaderboard copy

rules.voteMajority: strictly more than half (3 of 5); ties rejected
rules.assassination: after good wins 3 quests the Assassin picks any other seat; hitting Merlin makes evil win
hidden: other players' roles until the match ends
individual approval votes while a vote is open
